decision: reported omission is false under actual zero-based canonical matrix definition
actual_defining_context: def-matrix-space explicitly defines M_(m x n)(F)=F^(m x n) with m={0,...,m-1}, n={0,...,n-1}, a_ij for i<m,j<n; both indices start at 0. prop-standard-coordinate-inner-products and lem-standard-basis-of-f-n use k<n with coordinates indexed 0,...,n-1.
independent_check: For a 1x1 matrix the double sum has the single entry a_00, so it equals |a_00|, not zero. (m,n) is outside the matrix index domain and cannot witness a missing valid entry. j+i*n is exactly the zero-based full coordinate flattening. A one-based reindex b_(i+1,j+1)=a_ij preserves the full-entry sum.
